newsitem.title: FRANCE: Templeton cuts stake in Eramet - CMF.
newsitem.headline: Templeton cuts stake in Eramet - CMF.

text.p: Templeton Global Investors Inc has lowered its holding in nickel producer Eramet to below five percent, the French financial markets regulator CMF (Conseil des Marches Financiers) said on Tuesday.

It said Templeton declared on August 1 that it held 759,793 shares, or 4.90 percent of Eramet, through investment funds and accounts under management. It has 4.99 percent of the voting rights, the CMF said in a statement.
Templeton rose above the five percent threshold in February when it increased its stake in Eramet to 5.40 percent.
The U.S. fund cut its stake a day after Eramet, 55 percent owned by state holding company Erap, agreed at its annual meeting to resolutions to protect minority shareholders.

The resolutions were proposed by British and U.S. funds after a row sparked by government moves last year to transfer part of Eramet's mining assets to Kanak separatist interests teamed up with Canada's Falconbridge to quell political tensions.
